purpose: Calibrate Hera's automated luxury-hospitality certification without allowing public research to override Hera policy, current business facts or authorised human decisions.
globalRules: Hera's approved Service Constitution and Stage 2 authority catalogues remain the only authority for Hera-specific facts, policies and actions.
Research sources may define evaluation methods, service-quality dimensions, scenario patterns and judge-bias controls only.
Public reviews and datasets must never be copied into client replies, treated as Hera facts or used to infer a real person's identity, condition or appointment.
No source creates or implies an affiliation between Hera and The Ritz-Carlton, Marriott, Yelp, NIST or any research publisher.
Copyrighted review text is not committed to this repository. Only anonymised themes, statistics, hashes and independently written scenarios may be retained.
A source disagreement with the approved Hera constitution is resolved in favour of the Hera constitution.
